content: Lenis needs explicit wiring for SPA route changes and anchor links: reinitialize/refresh on route change, and use lenis.scrollTo(hash) in an effect after navigation rather than relying on native anchor jump (Link scroll={false} + manual scrollTo). Also must swap overflow-x:hidden for clip and add self-start to sticky elements or sticky breaks under Lenis. Smooth scroll is cheap to add poorly and hard to add well; most sites that ship it skip the integration work (sticky, anchors, reduced-motion) and it ends up worse than no smooth scroll.
